title: The scheme family and when each one settles
caption: Four schemes, from simplest to most stateful. exact settles once; upto settles a metered amount under a ceiling that the client signs on EVM or escrows on Solana; batch-settlement serves on an off-chain voucher and settles in batches later; auth-capture holds funds, captures later and allows refunds. Dates are the first merge of each spec file.
alt: Four groups. Exact, specified since 2025-02 before the launch: the client signs the exact amount and one transfer follows the handler; the Lightning binding of 2026-09-23 is paid upfront. Upto, 2026-03-04: the client signs a ceiling on EVM or escrows it on Solana, the server settles the metered amount up to the ceiling, and on EVM a zero charge needs no transaction. Batch-settlement, 2026-04-15, formerly called deferred: a deposit opens a channel, each request carries a cumulative voucher and is served at once, and claims and one settlement come later for many vouchers; the cloudflare:402 variant is credit that Cloudflare bills later. Auth-capture, 2026-05-13: authorize places a hold before the handler, capture or void follows, refunds are possible until the refund deadline, and the client can reclaim after the capture deadline.
